name: math_derivative_operator

phase_0.boundary_condition: the space of infinitely differentiable functions on a smooth manifold

VINIT.justification: the state prior to the definition of any functional relationship or coordinate system

TANCH.justification: the closed container defining the valid domain and codomain for the operator

AFWD.justification: the forward transformation mapping a function to its rate of change

AREV.justification: the reverse transformation mapping a rate of change back to a primitive function

CLINK.justification: the sequential application of the derivative operator to its own output

IMSCRIB.justification: the recognition of the function as itself within the mapping space

FSPLIT.justification: the branching of the derivative of a product into two distinct additive terms

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the total derivative from the branched product rule terms

EVALT.justification: the affirmative state where the limit defining the derivative exists

EVALF.justification: the negative state where the function is non-differentiable or the limit diverges

ENGAGR.justification: a state where a function is not classically differentiable yet possesses a derivative in the sense of distributions

IFIX.chosen_element: the derivative value at a point
IFIX.justification: the permanent fixation of a numerical slope at a specific coordinate

phase_3.void_description: the absence of any defined mapping or topological space
phase_3.true_description: a well defined smooth mapping with a convergent limit at every point
phase_3.false_description: a discontinuity or cusp preventing the existence of a tangent vector
phase_3.both_description: a distribution or generalized function existing in the overlap of classical and non-classical analysis

steps.domain_action: establish the initial empty functional space
identify the input function f within the smooth algebra
apply the Leibniz rule to a product of functions
verify the first term u dv is well defined
compute the forward morphism of the first term
check for singularities in the second term v du
verify the second term remains within the integrable boundary
sum the terms to reconstitute the total derivative
compose the result with a second application of the operator
evaluate the result at a point of weak differentiability
record the final derivative value into the permanent manifold state
close the operation within the terminal boundary of the algebra

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the formal rules of calculus and limit definitions
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the chain rule passing local slope information between nested functions
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the coefficients and exponents stored in the functional expression
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the order of operations defined by the operator precedence

phase_6.cycle_cost: the reduction in polynomial degree or loss of constant information
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: a function of higher complexity or unknown rate of change
phase_6.post_cycle_state: a function representing the exact local linearization of the input
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the information lost in the constant is preserved in the boundary conditions
